Vish Sridhara, PhD

Bioinformatics Solutions Architect

Google Scholar GitHub LinkedIn
Cloud Architecture · AI · Scientific Computing

I design data and AI solutions that help science-driven and regulated-health organizations turn complex data into dependable, decision-ready outcomes. With 10+ years across biotech, consulting and federal organizations, including NIH and FDA, I cover the full data lifecycle, from ingestion and quality control to analytics and delivery.

My roots in engineering and computational sciences let me work with both the scientists asking the questions and the engineers building the platforms that answer them.

What I do

Solution architecture

End-to-end genomics data platforms and pipelines, from ingestion and QC to analytics and delivery (Nextflow, Snakemake, Databricks, ETL/ELT, orchestration).

Cloud

AWS (S3, EC2) and Azure (Data Factory, Databricks), with Docker and CI/CD for reproducible deployment.

Applied AI/ML

PyTorch, TensorFlow, and MLflow, including protein language models such as ESM-2 on antibody data.

Life sciences

Bulk and single-cell RNA-seq, antibody repertoires, multi-omics, and regulated NIH/FDA data environments.

Selected experience

Senior Bioinformatics Scientist, Argentys Informatics
